description: Check that scholarly, legal and web citations are real and say what they claim, via Crossref, DataCite, OpenAlex, PubMed, the Caselaw Access Project and the Wayback Machine. POST /v1/verify with {citations} (up to 10) and get a verdict per citation (verified, mismatch, not_found, retracted, ambiguous, unverifiable) with the matched record and field-level mismatches as one JSON object. POST /v1/claim with {claim, citation or evidence_text} to learn whether the source supports the claim. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

citations: Brown v. Board of Education, 347 U.S. 483 (1954)
Vaswani et al. (2017). Attention Is All You Need. NeurIPS.
